C0938.title: JD Finance Assists Police in Dismantling 'Debt Optimization' Fraud Ring
C0938.summary: A criminal gang operating under the guise of a consulting firm in Jiangxi used 'debt optimization' and 'proxy rights protection' as pretexts to defraud financial consumers of their assets and harvest personal information. Police apprehended seven suspects, and the case is now under further judicial processing.

references.title: Beware of 'Anti-Collection' Traps! JD Finance Assists Police in Solving Financial Fraud Case_China.com
